id: title:Gilbert09:restart notion page id enumeration on stale search cursor

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion recovery for Notion connector
review.reason: Adds a bounded recovery mechanism: clears an invalid cursor and restarts pagination on NotionBadRequestError, preventing warehouse import failure. This is a substantive, localized reliability improvement.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk; no test execution or runtime behavior observed. Benefit is inferred from recovery logic, not demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance verified.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a try/except block around the Notion page-search request; on NotionBadRequestError, checks if the cursor is invalid and, if so, clears the cursor and restarts pagination from the beginning. Other bad requests are re-raised.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent warehouse ingestion failures when Notion returns a stale cursor mid-pagination, allowing the warehouse connector to recover and complete the page-id enumeration rather than failing the entire warehouse import.
